title: Old car headlights were all the same — which was a fairly bright idea
summary: Technology Connections explains why American cars all had the same standardized sealed-beam headlights until 1957. It covers the regulations behind the design and the effect on night visibility.
why: Recommended as a clear explanation of why old headlights looked as they did, and as a case study in mandating requirements versus solutions.

quote.text: has, as so often the case, a great video about why old car headlights were the shapes they were
